 ‘Ghost Rider’: ‘Heated Rivalry’ Breakout Connor Storrie In Talks For Co-Lead Opposite Ryan Gosling, Possibly As Villain
 The “Heated Rivalry” breakout is reportedly in talks for a co-leading role opposite Ryan Gosling in Shawn Levy’s upcoming Marvel film, potentially as its main villain.
 By Rodrigo Perez 
 October 27, 2026 5:13 pm 
 0 
 13 
 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Over the last year, the popular HBO series “ Heated Rivalry ” has made Connor Storrie  one of television’s biggest breakout stars, and Marvel Studios may be looking to capitalize on that momentum. The actor is reportedly in talks for a co-leading role opposite Ryan Gosling in “ Ghost Rider ,” with Shawn Levy directing. His character remains unknown, though speculation suggests he could play the film’s main villain.
 READ MORE: ‘Ghost Rider’: Ryan Gosling Officially Cast As Johnny Blaze In Marvel’s 2028 Film 
 According to Knight Edge Media (confirmed by THR), Storrie has been offered a co-leading role in the film, though the deal hasn’t been finalized. The outlet also reports that the actor didn’t have to audition for the part, suggesting Marvel is particularly keen to bring him into the MCU.
 It would certainly be a big career move for Storrie, who became an overnight sensation thanks to his performance in HBO’s aforementioned gay hockey drama. Before that, he had a small but memorable appearance in Todd Phillips ’ “ Joker: Folie à Deux ,” playing the inmate who kills Joaquin Phoenix ’s Arthur Fleck in the film’s final moments. Now he could trade hockey skates for something a little more hellish.
 As for who Storrie might play, or what other characters could be involved, that’s still anyone’s guess. The MCU already has a few supernatural figures waiting in the wings, including Mephisto, played by Sacha Baron Cohen in “ Ironheart ,” and the characters introduced in “ Werewolf by Night ,” including Gael García Bernal as Jack Russell, Laura Donnelly as Elsa Bloodstone, and Carey Jones as Man-Thing. There’s also the long-discussed possibility of a “ Midnight Sons ” team-up , bringing together characters like Moon Knight, played by Oscar Isaac , and other supernatural heroes. Fans have anticipated that crossover for years, though it’s unclear how soon Marvel might pursue it or how much groundwork “Ghost Rider” could lay. Either way, the film seems like a natural place to start.
 Gosling’s involvement was officially announced at San Diego Comic-Con earlier this year , ending years of speculation about the actor joining the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Levy, who previously directed “ Deadpool & Wolverine ,” is reuniting with Gosling after their upcoming “ Star Wars: Starfighter ,” while Jonathan Tropper , who also wrote that film, is handling the screenplay .
 Another interesting development sits behind the camera, too. According to THR , Oscar-winner Linus Sandgren (“ Dune: Part Three ”) will serve as cinematographer, and the production will shoot on film, a choice that could give Marvel’s supernatural material a distinctive visual texture from their previous films.
 The new movie marks Ghost Rider’s return to the big screen after Nicolas Cage played Johnny Blaze in 2007’s “Ghost Rider” and 2012’s “ Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance .” Gosling had previously acknowledged discussions with Marvel about taking on the character , though the studio has yet to reveal much about its take on the supernatural antihero.

 According to Knight Edge Media, production is expected to begin in early 2027, with filming planned in Nevada, Oregon, and California. Marvel has not officially confirmed Storrie’s involvement, so for now, this remains a potential casting rather than a done deal.
 “Ghost Rider” is scheduled to hit theaters on July 28, 2028.
